name: One World International School
summary: IB programmes with campuses serving west and other corridors at relatively accessible fees.
body: OWIS positions as a more accessible IB option versus legacy mega-campuses. Campus locations have expanded over time — match the site to your commute. Useful comparison school when packages are mid-range. Confirm how external ed-psych reports are reviewed and whether tutoring on campus is facilitated or parent-managed.
waitlistNotes: Generally more mid-year flexibility — still confirm by grade.
